text:
Hi Leo,

I’m on leave this week so we will have to skip our catch up on Friday and instead meet up on the 28th Feb.

I’ve been consulting my key stakeholders who run all the different imaging pipelines within Syngenta that use SIMPL as the foundation stone from which to export the images and annotations to start model training. It’s the stakeholders that wield the power for any decision on moving vendor. In summary, for technical and political reasons they are not motivated to move platform provider at this particular point in time so 2025 may not be the right time for us. subject: Re: Encord migration - project thread
text:
Hi Nick,

It was a pleasure meeting you yesterday, and I appreciate your ongoing
support.

Following up on our discussion, I’d like to confirm that the hotkeys are
good to go into production. Additionally, I’d like to request a
customization for the "Pan" feature. Currently, panning requires holding *Shift
+ Left Click*, whereas in edit mode, currently, we use only the left button
to pan images. Allowing panning with just the left button will
significantly improve efficiency, as annotators and reviewers frequently
pan while performing QC. This adjustment would ease the burden of
repeatedly pressing *Shift*.

Please find below:

   - A list of suggestions based on our review of the training material.
   - A list of essential workflow features that need to be incorporated for
   a smooth transition, as some key elements are currently missing. We will
   further be updating as we discover on the go as well.

Encord Training Videos Feedback - Features
<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TauOaUp5ngOuJZdq19lJFIF9IQi5asEfMYmA-pE5VI0/edit?gid=0#gid=0>

We are also compiling a list of emails and selected members for the first
training batch, which we will share once finalized.

Additionally, please let us know once the defect labeling datasets have
been uploaded.

Happy to jump on a call if you'd like to discuss these requests in more
detail and their significance to our current workflows.

Best,

Haider
